description: Install or update the ctrlPi API agent on a Pico W, Pico 2 W, ESP32, ESP32-S3 or ESP32-C3 running MicroPython (pico-gpio-api or esp32-gpio-api, downloaded from GitHub). Writes app.mpy, upgrader.mpy and main.py (plus boot.py on an ESP32), then config.json (the board's own kept, with this api_key and name), wifi.txt and scripts/cpu-temp.py when missing, and resets the board. It replaces main.py, so ask the user first and pass confirmed: true.

api_key.description: Agent API key. Left out: the board's own key, else your-secret-key (public, so change it).

board_id.description: Stable board UID returned by pico_boards_list, or its current serial device path.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly confirms the install.

name.description: Agent name. Left out: the board's own name, else the agent's pico-<serial4> or esp32-<serial4> default; an empty string resets it to that default.

wifi_password.description: Wi-Fi password (empty for an open network).

name: pico_ctrlpi_install
title: Install the ctrlPi API on a board
